root_causes.defect: Official no-game responses represented as dates=[] could not create a plan, and a zero-target plan crashed the tick and health paths.
root_causes.affected_scope: Off-days and other valid official dates without scheduled MLB games.
root_causes.repair: Permit the explicit official empty-date representation only in plan construction; publish and independently verify a zero-target source receipt without constructing a ledger or fetching at T-4.

root_causes.defect: A completed source_error or missed terminal state was reported as healthy and the health command exited successfully.
root_causes.affected_scope: Network loss, source failure, late execution, and process-health alerting.
root_causes.repair: Classify source_error or missed states as terminal_collection_failure, retain the immutable health report, and exit nonzero so systemd and GitHub can alert.

root_causes.defect: The systemd tick ran every 60 seconds although the locked runtime declared a 15-second scheduler cadence.
root_causes.repair: Bind the systemd timer to 15 seconds and mutation-test the deployed unit against the locked runtime.

root_causes.defect: Plan timeliness was checked against the pre-fetch clock, allowing a slow plan request to complete after a target became due.
root_causes.affected_scope: Plan publication near the first T-4 horizon.
root_causes.repair: Use the later of the invocation clock and the retained response-receipt clock; refuse publication at or after any target.

root_causes.defect: No independent GitHub path replayed retained raw schedule bytes through the exact plan, source receipt, ledger, and health chain.
root_causes.affected_scope: Secondary verification, durable backup, and silent server failure detection.
root_causes.repair: Add an hourly read-only workflow and offline verifier; it cannot write the server or fetch replacement receipts.

root_causes.defect: Pitcher-receipt units shared the future full-collector checkout path and had no exact-commit installation boundary.
root_causes.repair: Use an isolated release/evidence root and an exact-commit installer with a pinned official GitHub host key, clean-checkout validation, offline gates, and only the three receipt timers.

deployment.reason: Exact release heads are not yet landed and the exact-release installer has not been run on the host.
deployment.next_action: Land the verifier dependency and this hardened receipt release under exact-head authorization, then install the resulting exact commit on AWS and verify the first future-only plan/tick/health cycle.
